day_local: Axadda Afraad iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbigu waa naxariis iyo raxmad badan, wuu gaabiyaa cadhada, wuxuuna hodan ku yahay naxariis.
homily:
Bal qiyaas adigoo taagan garoonka diyaaradaha, adigoo daawanaya diyaaradaha oo hawada kor u kacaya. Waxaad arkeysaa Benjamin Vo oo indhihiisu ay ka buuxaan raynrayn. Wuxuu si taxaddar leh u eegayaa mishiinnada, wuxuuna ku riyoonayaa 'Con Chim Airlines'. Waxay ahayd daqiiqad fudud, laakiin waxay xambaarsanayd jacaylka uu u qabay abuurista iyo ujeeddada. Maanta, akhriska koowaad ee kitaabka Sirakh wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Xusuuso maalmahaaga dambe, cadhada iska fogee.' Waa xusuusin ah in nolosha ay tahay wax kooban oo qaali ah, oo ay tahay inaan ku noolaanno jacayl, ee aynaan ku noolaan xanaaq ama xisaabtan.

Ciise wuxuu Injiilka maanta inoo sheegayaa inaan cafino 'todobaatan jeer todoba.' Peter wuxuu u maleeyay inuu aad u deeqsi ahaa markuu soo jeediyay todoba jeer, laakiin Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in cafisku aanu ahayn wax la xisaabiyo. Cafisku waa qaab nololeed. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo bixiyo jacayl aan xisaab lahayn. Xusuusnow markuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar adeerkiis William? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbigiisu uu u furan yahay dadka kale. 

Alan iyo Thao, saddex bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale, June 13, 2026. Waxaan ogahay in gurigiina uu leeyahay aamusnaan aan la sharxi karin. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta idiin sheego si cad oo naxariis leh: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay xertiisa markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha, wuxuu yidhi: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Xanuunka iyo dhimashada ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Waxaad Ben siiseen nolosha ugu quruxda badan ee waalid uu wiil siin karo. Jacaylkaaga, Alan, ee aad u sheegi jirtay sheekooyinka aad ku qosli jirteen, iyo taageeradaada, Thao, waxay ahaayeen nuurkii uu Ben ku koray. Waxaad ahaydeen waalidkii ugu fiicnaa. Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. 

Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Haddii aynu nool nahay, Rabbiga ayaannu u nool nahay, haddii aynu dhimannona, Rabbiga ayaannu u dhimannaa.' Tani waa xujada nolosha. Ben wuxuu hadda ku jiraa gacmaha Rabbiga. Wuxuu ka xor yahay xanuun kasta. Markii aad ku riyootay, Alan, inuu Ben kuu sheegay 'Ba, test-ka waan ka gudbay,' taasi waa xaqiiqda dhabta ah ee nolosha weligeed ah. Ben wuu kula socdaa, wuxuuna kaa codsanayaa inaad sii wadato nolosha. 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay adiga kugu adkaayeen. Waxaad weyday walaalkaa, saaxiibkaa, iyo kii aad la wadaagi jirtay qolka iyo riyooyinka. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu yahay mid ku eegaya dhoolacaddayn. Sii wad inaad u noolaato si geesinimo leh, waayo xiriirka idinka dhexeeya ma go'in; wuxuu ku jiraa xiriirka quduuska ah ee salaadda. Sii wad inaad riyooto, sii wad inaad noolaato, waayo Ben wuxuu doonayaa inaad faraxsan tahay. 

Ceelka biyaha ee 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' ee Cà Mau waa calaamad muujinaysa in naxariistii Ben ay weli u qulqulayso sidii biyo nadiif ah oo kale, iyadoo quudinaysa dadka oomman. Magaciisa 'Đại Dương' oo macnaheedu yahay Badweyn Weyn wuxuu inoo xusuusinayaa in naxariista Ilaah ay ka ballaaran tahay murugo kasta. Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada kaliya markaad dhex joogto xanuunka. U dhiib shabaggaaga gacmaha Rabbiga. Ha isku dayin inaad xalliso xanuunka adiga oo keligaa ah. U ogolow Ciise inuu kula socdo. Benjamin, wiilkaygii qaaliga ahaa, noo ducee. Noo ducee annaga oo halkan joogna, si aan u helno xoog aan ku sii soconno, illaa aan mar kale kulanno oo aan aragno dhoolacaddayntaada quruxda badan albaabka Jannada. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramenti Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuugu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Sakramenti, fadlan qalbigayga ugu kaalay si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidaad hore u joogtay, waxaana naftayda u midaynayaa adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha ina barakeeyo, ha inoo naxariisto, oo ha ina siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu baryaynaa Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwa naga hor maray, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nasasho weligeed ah oo uu ku ifiyo nuurkiisa aan damayn.
Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu baryaynaa dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan qoyska Benjamin, inuu Rabbigu qalbigooda u dejiyo nabad, rajo, iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Cadhada iyo xanaaqu waa waxyaabo neceb, haddana dembiiluhu wuu isku duubaa. Qofkii aargoosta Rabbigu wuu ka aargoosan doonaa, waayo wuxuu xusuustaa dembiyadooda si faahfaahsan. Cafi dulmiga deriskaaga; markaas markaad tukato, dembiyadaada waa la cafiyi doonaa. Qof ma quudin karaa cadho uu u qabo qof kale oo filan karaa bogsasho xagga Rabbiga? Qof ma diidi karaa naxariis uu u qabo qof la mid ah, oo filan karaa cafis dembiyadiisa? Haddii qof jidh uun ah uu cadho xajisto, yaa cafiyi doona dembiyadiisa? Xusuuso maalmahaaga dambe, cadhada iska fogee; xusuuso dhimashada iyo qudhunka, oo dembiga ka joogso! Ka fikir amarrada, ha necebin deriskaaga; xusuuso axdiga Ilaaha ugu sarreeya, oo iska indho-tir khaladaadka.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbigu waa naxariis iyo raxmad badan, wuu gaabiyaa cadhada, wuxuuna hodan ku yahay naxariis. Rabbiga ammaana, naftaydoy; oo dhammaan waxa igu jira, magiciisa quduuska ah ha ammaaneen. Rabbiga ammaana, naftaydoy, oo ha ilaawin dhammaan nicmadiisa. Rabbigu wuu cafiyaa dhammaan xumaantiinna, wuxuuna bogsiiyaa dhammaan xanuunnadiinna. Wuxuu naftaada ka soo furtay baabba', wuxuuna kuu taajay naxariis iyo raxmad. Rabbigu had iyo goor ma eedeyn doono, mana hayn doono cadhadiisa weligeed. Sida dembiyadeenna uma macaamilo inala, mana noo abaalmariyo sida xumaanteenna. Sida samadu ay uga sarreyso dhulka, ayaa naxariistiisu uga sarreysaa kuwa isaga ka cabsada. Sida bari ay uga fog tahay galbeed, ayuu dembiyadeenna nooga fogeeyay.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Midkeen nolosha uma noola, midkeenna dhimashada uma dhinto. Waayo haddii aynu nool nahay, Rabbiga ayaannu u nool nahay, haddii aynu dhimannona, Rabbiga ayaannu u dhimannaa; sidaas darteed, haddii aynu nool nahay ama aynu dhimannay, aynu Rabbiga nahay. Waayo tani waa sababta Masiixu u dhintay oo u soo noolaaday, si uu u noqdo Rabbiga kuwa dhintay iyo kuwa noolba.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Peter ayaa u soo dhawaaday Ciise oo weydiiyay, “Rabbiyow, haddii walaalkay igu dembaabo, imisa jeer ayaan cafiyayaa? Ilaa todoba jeer?” Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay, “Waxaan kugu leeyahay, ma aha todoba jeer, laakiin todobaatan jeer todoba.” Taasi waa sababta boqortooyada jannada loogu matali karo boqor goostay inuu xisaab la galo addoomadiisa. Markuu bilaabay xisaabinta, waxaa la keenay addoon ku lahaa lacag badan. Maadaama uusan haysan waddo uu ku bixiyo, sayidkiisii wuxuu amar ku bixiyay in la iibiyo, isaga, xaaskiisa, carruurtiisa, iyo dhammaan hantidiisa, si uu deynta u bixiyo. Markaas, addoonkii wuxuu u dhacay sayidkiisii, wuxuuna ku yidhi, ‘Iska samir, waanan kuu bixin doonaa si dhammaystiran.’ Sayidkii addoonkaas oo ay naxariis gashay ayaa sii daayay oo u cafiyay deyntii. Markuu addoonkii baxay, wuxuu helay mid ka mid ah addoomadii ay wada shaqaynayeen oo ku lahaa lacag aad u yar. Wuxuu qabtay isagoo ceejinaya, isagoo dalbanaya, ‘Bixi wixii aad igu leedahay.’ Isagoo jilbaha u dhacaya, addoonkii kale wuxuu baryay, ‘Iska samir, waanan kuu bixin doonaa.’ Laakiin wuu diiday. Taa beddelkeeda, wuxuu addoonkii kale ku xidhay xabsi ilaa uu ka bixiyo deynta. Markii addoomadii kale ay arkeen wixii dhacay, aad bay u murugodeen, waxayna u tageen sayidkoodii oo u sheegeen wixii dhacay. Sayidkiisii ayaa u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, ‘Addoon xunow! Waan kuu cafiyay dhammaan deyntaada markaad i bariday. Miyaanay ahayn inaad naxariis u yeelato addoonka kula shaqaynaya, sidaan anigu kuu naxariistay?’ Markaas sayidkii oo cadhaysan ayaa u dhiibay kuwa jirdila ilaa uu ka bixiyo dhammaan deynta. Sidaasuu Aabbahayga jannada ku jiraa idinku samayn doonaa, haddii midkiinba uusan walaalkiis ka cafin qalbigiisa.”

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Dear Ben, our uncle Thanh has passed away. Please watch over him and pray that his soul finds peace. His saint name is Phêrô. Lord, thank you for sending Chu Thanh into my life. I'll always be grateful for the time he spent tutoring me in math back in high school
